bigIdea.en: Plants are living things. Each part of a plant has a job, and every plant goes through a life cycle as it grows.
bigIdea.es: Las plantas son seres vivos. Cada parte de una planta tiene una función, y toda planta pasa por un ciclo de vida mientras crece.

definition.en: All the stages a living thing goes through, from the start of its life until it makes new life.
definition.es: Todas las etapas por las que pasa un ser vivo, desde el comienzo de su vida hasta que crea nueva vida.

supports.example: A bean plant has a life cycle that begins with a seed.

supports.purpose: Shows who did what, where and when in a long sentence, so a student can follow the grammar and not just the words.
supports.sentence: Roots grow down into the soil.

explain.en: Who is the sentence about? Roots. What do they do? They grow down. Where? Into the soil.
explain.es: ¿De quién habla la oración? De las raíces. ¿Qué hacen? Crecen hacia abajo. ¿Dónde? En la tierra.

supports.purpose: Shows who did what, where and when in a long sentence, so a student can follow the grammar and not just the words.
supports.sentence: The roots take in water and nutrients.

explain.en: The roots are the doers. “Take in” is the action. “Water and nutrients” is what they take in.
explain.es: Las raíces son quienes hacen la acción. “Absorben” es la acción. “Agua y nutrientes” es lo que absorben.

supports.purpose: Shows who did what, where and when in a long sentence, so a student can follow the grammar and not just the words.
supports.sentence: A stem grows up toward the light.

explain.en: A stem is the doer. It grows up. “Toward the light” tells which way.
explain.es: Un tallo es quien hace la acción. Crece hacia arriba. “Hacia la luz” dice en qué dirección.

bigIdea.en: People solve problems by finding ways to harness energy from nature, and engineers keep testing and improving their designs.
bigIdea.es: Las personas resuelven problemas al encontrar maneras de aprovechar la energía de la naturaleza, y los ingenieros siguen probando y mejorando sus diseños.

definition.en: the power that makes things move, heat up, or light up

supports.example: A wind turbine turns the energy of moving air into electricity.

definition.en: able to be replaced by nature, so it does not run out

supports.example: Sunlight is a renewable source of energy.

supports.purpose: Shows who did what, where and when in a long sentence, so a student can follow the grammar and not just the words.
supports.sentence: Long ago, people learned to harness the wind and flowing water.

explain.en: Start with “Long ago” to find when. People are the doers. They learned to harness, which means to put nature to use. What did they harness? The wind and flowing water.
explain.es: “Hace mucho tiempo” dice cuándo. Las personas son quienes hacen la acción. Aprendieron a aprovechar, es decir, a usar la naturaleza. ¿Qué aprovecharon? El viento y el agua que corre.

supports.purpose: Shows who did what, where and when in a long sentence, so a student can follow the grammar and not just the words.
supports.sentence: These machines did not burn anything.

explain.en: “These machines” are the doers. “Did not burn” tells what they did not do. “Anything” is the thing they did not burn.
explain.es: “Estas máquinas” son quienes hacen la acción. “No quemaron” dice lo que no hicieron. “Nada” es lo que no quemaron.

supports.purpose: Shows who did what, where and when in a long sentence, so a student can follow the grammar and not just the words.
supports.sentence: A wind turbine changes moving air into electricity.

explain.en: A wind turbine is the doer. It changes one thing into another: moving air becomes electricity.
explain.es: Una turbina eólica es quien hace la acción. Cambia una cosa en otra: el aire en movimiento se convierte en electricidad.
